boxes.meaning: something romantic going on between two people

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an object, stuff, a creature, an actual phenomenon, a dismissively mentioned situation, or a romantic involvement in 有嘢.

boxes.note: Only has this sense in the set phrase 有嘢.

examples.english: There’s definitely a thing between those two.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zan1 hai6 jau5 je5 wo3

english.note: Use 嘢 as the all-purpose casual noun for miscellaneous things, personal effects, unspecified matters, or unnamed material.
Use 嘢 as the all-purpose spoken word for a physical, inanimate thing.
Use this for a vaguely named physical object when its exact name is unknown.
Use this when guy refers loosely to a thing or object rather than a person.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 di1 je5 fong3 zo2 hai2 dou6
go2 gin6 je5 m4 hou2 baai2 hai2 dou6
nei1 gin6 je5 hai6 jung6 lei4 zou6 mat1 gaa3

examples.english: This guy is pretty useful in the kitchen.
examples.traditional: 呢件嘢擺喺廚房幾好用。
